messages:
Clara Nguyen: Pushing a compact row design for latency cards. p95 big, small throughput sparkline below, and a tiny 'Sampling' badge top-right that opens an inline popover. Attached quick mock. Thoughts on keyboard nav and screen-reader labels? :wave: Devon Park: Nice and tight. Make p95 the visual anchor. Throughput needs explicit unit "Throughput (RPS)". Badge should show current mode (Adaptive / 10%). :eyes: Ravi Patel: Accessibility: badge must be focusable, aria-expanded + aria-controls. Popover should use role=\"dialog\" and announce when opened via live region. Add sr-only copy explaining sampling. Lena Ortiz: Copy: use "Sampling: Adaptive" (capitalized). Badge tooltip: "Controls how many requests are drawn to reduce noise & cost." Popover title: "Sampling settings". Jorge Morales: On narrow widths we should hide throughput and mobile should show p95 only. Consider collapsing throughput into an icon that expands. DesignBot: automated-lint: contrast-fail on badge text at current color; recommend darker token or bold weight. :robot_face: Samira Lee: Product: if we show an "est. cost" line in the popover (eg "est. $0.02 / 1k") add clarifying copy: "Estimated rendering cost for sampled traces only; not a billing line." Maybe hide cost behind opt-in toggle. Clara Nguyen: Interaction notes: keyboard shortcut `t` toggles timepicker. When popover opens focus goes to first control. Draft ARIA snippet for frontend: ```
...
``` Devon Park: Timepicker keyboard: left/right move range, Shift+left/right jump larger intervals. Also show exact RPS on sparkline hover. Ravi Patel: SR updates: announce "Sampling settings opened. Currently Adaptive at 10%" and announce slider value changes via polite live region. Lena Ortiz: Final microcopy: Badge "Sampling: Adaptive"; Popover title "Sampling settings"; help link text "What is sampling?" linking to docs. Jorge Morales: Engineering: hide est. cost by default with small "Show est. cost" toggle inside popover. Clara Nguyen: Agreement. I'll update the figma and post link when ready. :raised_hands: DesignBot: auto-archiver: thread tagged design-review; attach final figma link when ready.
